slides.title: Marathon, trek or pilgrimage?
slides.vo: Going for a marathon, a trek or a pilgrimage? Today - I am going to explain you "What is a Capping Card?"
Every day, the contest counts up to 15,000 steps. Anything above that doesn't count. Some days, you go big.
Members told us: on those days, I give everything. Can that whole effort count?

slides.title: The Capping Card
slides.vo: So we built the Capping Card.

slides.title: Cap lifts to 25,000
slides.vo: On the day you choose, your daily cap lifts from 15,000 to 25,000 steps.
And those extra steps count up to your deficit. The steps you're behind.

slides.title: Up to 20,000
slides.vo: Deficit of 5,000? Steps are counted up to 20,000, nothing more after that.

slides.title: The full 10,000
slides.vo: Deficit of 20,000? The entire 10,000 extra, from 15,000 to 25,000, counts.

slides.title: Today and future days
slides.vo: Capping works on today and future days.
And it's the only card you can reschedule before the day. Race date changed? Just move your card.
No deficit? Save it. And remember, you only need to do enough to clear your deficit. Steps beyond that won't add anything.
"Big day. Full effort. Make it count."

slides.title: Be a true Cheetah
slides.vo: For the odd days when you are out of the Urban Jungle and become a true Cheetah ;)
